brewing.notes: A safe starting point for green tea: cooler water, short steeps, then adjust by taste.

description:
A clonal, medium-leaf, early shrub cultivar bred at Hunan Agricultural University by single-plant selection from a natural hybrid. It is grown for green tea.

This is a tea plant cultivar rather than a finished tea, so you are more likely to meet its name in a grower's notes than on a packet. If you find tea made from it, brew it like any other green tea and taste what the plant brings.
history: The university's tea science department holds the variety. Trials at Gaoqiao in Changsha County recorded the first two-leaf flush on 6 April 2010 and 4 April 2011. It is widely planted in Hunan and has spread to areas such as Hangzhou.
processing: A plant cultivar, not a processing style: it is usually made into green tea, and the method is up to the grower.
harvest_season: Depends on the place and the grower.
appearance_dry: Tight, slender, long strands of emerald green.
taste_profile: High, sharp aroma and a mellow, brisk taste.
vintage_note: A cultivar is not sold by vintage. Tea made from it follows the usual pattern for green tea, so ask for the harvest year and the grower.
